Metadata.title: Hissiyat | Human experience and social patterns
Metadata.description: A research platform supporting the exploration of human experience and social patterns in online data.

Home.title: Hissiyat
Home.description: An AI-supported research platform that aims to explore how topics, emotions, needs, and experiences relate to one another and change over time in online data.
Home.statusDescription: The application foundation is being prepared. Data collection and analysis features are not available yet.
Home.principleDescription: The aim is to support the study of patterns while preserving context and data limitations, rather than make definitive judgments about human experience.
